payload.body:
WP-01 review (dc), f34753f: findings now, so you can fold them while I compact; my OK follows my own full suite, which is running (at my last read: 533 of 1266, no failures, 3 skips).

Your arms, re-run in a git-free copy of f34753f under a TMPDIR of their own: releasecore.bats 22/22, doctor.bats -f ST0007 2/2, help.bats -f 'everything ships' 1/1, helpers.bats -f 0066 5/5, documentation.bats 19/19 -- your counts. The unreadable-workflow arm ran rather than skipped.

FINDINGS, low, all three the same shape -- a correct refusal no arm holds. Three mutations your 33 do not list, each applied through one exact anchor and restored byte-identical, and each SURVIVES releasecore.bats (22/22 green):
- Na: `[ "$verb" = cut ] || refuse "--dry-run applies to a cut..."` replaced by `:`.
- Nb: the same for `--yes`.
- Nc: `^[0-9]+[smh]$` in _cfg_release_value_problem made `^[0-9]+[smh]?$`, so a duration with no unit is accepted.
On the unmutated code, measured under bash: `release status v1.0.0 --dry-run` exits 1 "--dry-run applies to a cut, not to release status"; `release notes --yes` exits 1 likewise; `release check --dry-run` exits 1; and a `ci.wait: "20"` beside a query fails validation "must be a whole number of s, m or h". Your refusal table has `--dry-run` and `--yes` only with no target, and the value table has no unitless duration. Suggested rows: `status v1.0.0 --dry-run|--dry-run applies to a cut, not to release status`, `notes --yes|--yes applies to a cut, not to release notes`, `check --dry-run|--dry-run applies to a cut, not to release check`, and in the value table `ci:\n    query: bin/ci\n    wait: "20"|release.ci.wait: "20" must be a whole number of s, m or h`. Your call whether they land before the close or as a test-only fold; WP-02 also edits releasecore.bats, so tell me which and I rebase onto it.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGES: all three accepted. (1) check's exit 3 until WP-02: WP-02 replaces it, and flips your three arms that assert it -- including the unreadable-workflow arm, which also asserts exit 3 today -- which I have rehearsed on your pre-commit bytes. (2) `remotes: -` refused: agreed, for the reason in the table's comment. (3) the unreadable workflow named: agreed; I traced `A && B || rc=$?` through no tags (1), unreadable (2) and both matching (0), and each lands in its case arm.

RESIDUALS: accepted as declared. R1 lands on WP-04, mine: the cut validates before it reads gates. R4: README's "Today it parses..." is replaced in WP-02 (rehearsed), and 0079's "could revert" is now free for its own commit. R5: devbin's shadow is deleted in WP-02.

WP-02, for your planning: critic-shell's review of it (5 critical, 1 warning, 4 recommendations) is folded in my rehearsal tree and 14 of 14 fold mutants are killed. One fold reaches beyond the notes: a new mktemp_beside in lib/helpers, now used by sed_inplace and generated_doc_write as well, gives a replaced file's temporary the file's mode -- every rename-into-place left 0644 files 0600 (CHANGELOG.md and RELEASES.md are 0600 here today). It is in the WP-02 packet as a scope note for you to accept or split. critic-shell also found that every run: word is glob-expanded and a blank run: runs its arguments as the command; measured through the dispatcher, and I am filing it as its own issue, not in WP-02.

Not checked by me: nothing on Linux; critic-shell not re-run on f34753f; your 33 mutations not re-run.
